Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a descriptive discovery study aimed at identifying Nascent Pioneer Translation Products (Na-PTPs) across two different cell lines (HEK293 and H1299). It is not a differential perturbation study; therefore, it is mapped as 'un-classified'. Cycloheximide is used as a technical reagent to freeze ribosomes for polysome fractionation, not as a biological treatment variable for comparison. Other experiments mentioned (PBMC stimulation, plasmid transfection) are orthogonal validation assays and not the primary MS-analyzed samples.
